question: Which of the following forests are found in the higher latitudes of Northern hemisphere and are also called as Taiga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coniferous Forests. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coniferous Forests** are found in the higher latitudes of the Northern hemisphere and are also called as **Taiga**.
 
• The plants with cones and needles are called Coniferous-evergreen trees and the forests where these trees are found and coniferous forests. 
 
• These are found in higher latitudes (50° – 70°) of the Northern hemisphere. 
 
• They are also known as Taiga.
 
• The types of trees found in the reason include** Chir, pine, cedar, and Spruce.**
 
• The wildlife of such forests includes Silver fox, mink, polar bear, etc. 
 
• The trees in coniferous forests grow straight and tall.
 
• The coniferous trees attain a height of **about 30 m **while the **broad-leaved trees reach only 10 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tropical Deciduous Forest:

 
 
• Tropical Deciduous Forests, also known as** 'monsoon forests',** are of two types - Moist Deciduous Forests and Dry Deciduous Forests.
 
• The Tropical Moist Deciduous Forest is found in areas where **rainfall is between 100 and 200 cm, the average annual temperature is around 27ºC**, and the annual relative humidity is between 60-75%.
 
• These forests are mostly found in the northeastern states along the Himalayan foothills, eastern slopes of the Western Ghats, and the Indian states of** Chhattisgarh, Orissa, Bihar, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The main species included in these types of forests are - **Shisham, Teak, Sal, Sandalwood, Mahua, etc.**
 
• These forests also contain **open grass patches.**
 
 

 
• Tropical Rain Forest:

 
 
• These forests are found in places where the annual rainfall exceeds 250 cm, average annual humidity exceeds 77, and the annual temperature is about 25°-27°C.
 
• The main species included in these forests are - Jamun, bamboo, mahogany, white cedar, etc
 
 

 
• **Mediterranean Forest** are entirely confined to the western and south western portion of continental masses, **between 30° and 45° north and south of the equator.**

 
 
• The basic cause of this type of climate is the shifting of the wind belts.
 
• Mediterranean Sea has the greatest extent of this type of **‘winter rain climate’,** and gives rise to the name Mediterranean Climate.
 
• The Mediterranean lands receive **most of their precipitation in winter when the westerlies shift equatorward.**
